title: Layers, Objects, Overhead, Occlusion & Interactive Geometry
start_authority: Owner Continue freshly verified exact AIOC/application heads, re-read MAI-01..04 and resolved Scene/tabletop, Visibility/Permissions, Combat/Exploration, World and provenance seams before implementation.
objective: Implement deterministic provider-neutral presentation-layer, object, overhead, occlusion-candidate and interactive-geometry descriptors over completed MAI-02/03/04 contracts without creating runtime scene mutation, visibility authorization, line-of-sight truth, collision, cover, movement, combat, World topology or interaction state.

layer_model.rule: Extend MAI-02 layer/placeable records with deterministic presentation ordering and typed descriptive roles only.
layer_model.ordering: Sort by explicit order/elevation then stable layer/placeable ID; no runtime mutation.

geometry_model.rule: Geometry is finite deterministic presentation data with stable IDs and source/provenance references; it is not World topology or gameplay collision truth.

resolved_contract.overhead_model: Overhead records may describe visual stacking, clipping/mask candidates and source geometry, but cannot decide player visibility or runtime occlusion.

occlusion_model.rule: MAI may preserve/import an occlusion hint plus visibility-policy reference; authorization, hidden-state and line-of-sight decisions remain owner truth.

interactive_geometry.rule: An interaction hint requires an explicit external owner reference and cannot carry or mutate canonical open/closed, collision, movement, cover, trigger or combat state.

resolved_contract.privacy_evidence: Visibility projection filters unauthorized nodes/edges before topology/cardinality; MAI-05 therefore emits descriptors only and never bypasses a visibility projection receipt.
resolved_contract.combat_evidence: Combat validates line/visibility, range, movement, cover and effects in its own action lifecycle; MAI-05 never adjudicates those consequences.

acceptance_profile.provider_neutral: No Foundry wall, Tiled object/layer, LDtk entity/intgrid, or other vendor/editor model becomes canonical.
acceptance_profile.deterministic_geometry: Finite normalized primitives and deterministic stable ordering produce platform-identical receipts.
acceptance_profile.owner_boundaries: Scene placement/mutation, Visibility authorization/LOS, Combat collision/cover/movement, World topology and D29 provenance remain external owner truths.
acceptance_profile.predecessor_boundaries: Preserve MAI-01 license/incomplete-pack, MAI-02 provenance/unsupported metadata, MAI-03 projection and MAI-04 visual connectivity boundaries.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused MAI-05 verifier/client regression plus MAI-04/03/02/01 and World/visibility owner regressions, exact-head Repository Health, self-hosted Linux/Windows and deterministic comparison before merge.

nonauthorization: migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta
next_action: Implement only bounded MAI-05 descriptive geometry contracts and focused evidence on the registered branch; validate exact head, merge only after required gates pass, then close MAI-05 completed_verified and select MAI-06 without starting it.
